G5_natural_null_on_registered_class.note: the physical operator has rank 224 of 224 columns, so ker(A_physical | C_224) = {0} and there is no natural null direction to inject. Full column rank on a 224-dimensional discretised class is NOT a statement of continuum injectivity.

G5a_manufactured_exact_null.note: a duplicated column makes (+1, -1) an exact null vector known in closed form. Normalized data residual 1.115e-18; the numerical detector recovers it with overlap 1.000000 and reports nullity 1. Instrumentation only: this null direction was constructed, not discovered.

G5a_detector_recovers_the_known_vector.note: overlap between the closed-form null vector and the span the numerical detector returns

G5b_near_null_scaling_exponent.note: log-log slope of sigma_min against epsilon on the asymptotic branch (4 of 6 points, epsilon <= 1e-04) is 0.9997; a near-duplicate column should give exactly 1. Fitted across all points including the crossover it would read 0.7458, which measures where the manufactured direction overtakes the operator's own smallest singular value, not the scaling. Instrumentation only.

G5b_piecewise_model_residual.note: largest deviation from sigma_min = min(baseline, C*epsilon) with baseline 1.9841e-03 and C = 6.0912, relative to the baseline, over every epsilon. This is the full expected behaviour, floor included, rather than a slope on a hand-picked branch.

G5b_baseline_unperturbed_sigma_min.note: smallest singular value of the unaugmented physical operator, for reference: every G5b value must sit below it

protocol_deviations.effect: No macOS-specific or Apple-Silicon-specific result can be claimed. All float64 CPU numerics are platform-portable and unaffected; runtime and peak-RSS rows describe this Linux host, not a Mac.
